## Claim & Evidence

**Claim:** 海狸香 (hǎilíxiāng) is a Chinese incense ingredient (animal-derived, not botanical) — castoreum, a beaver (Castor fiber) secretion — with an aroma profile of animalic, leathery, smoky, sweet. Historical Western perfumery fixative; modern 'castoreum' is synthetic.
